summary: Mississippi State QB Kamario Taylor (turf toe) was downgraded to doubtful and is not expected to play per ESPN's Pete Thamel; freshman Parker 'Billy' Puckett would start, and leading rusher Fluff Bothwell is also doubtful. The market already moved hard on this (LSU -11.5/-14 to -17.5, total 58.5-59.5 to 56), so edges are modest; best lean is the Mississippi State team total under.

legs.desc: Mississippi State Bulldogs team total Under 19.5
legs.note: A freshman backup QB (3-for-6, 26 yds in relief vs Alabama) without lead RB Bothwell faces an LSU defense allowing about 176 pass ypg with nearly 4 sacks a game; pre-news models projected MSST around 23 with Taylor. Garbage-time points and LSU turnovers (Leavitt pick-six vs La Tech) are the main risk.

A freshman backup QB (3-for-6, 26 yds in relief vs Alabama) without lead RB Bothwell faces an LSU defense allowing about 176 pass ypg with nearly 4 sacks per game, and a big LSU lead likely means a run-heavy clock-draining second half. The total already dropped about 3 points, so only a modest edge remains.
MSST's offense should be weakest early before any garbage time, but LSU alone could cover much of this number, so it is only a slight lean.

Backup QB for MSST is strong evidence for LSU, but the line already moved from -11.5/-14 to -17.5 and LSU is 4-2 off an OT loss at Kentucky with a turnover-prone QB (Leavitt). Treat as close to fair; not a recommended pick.

research:
1. Home/atmosphere: Noon ET kickoff at Tiger Stadium (day game blunts the Death Valley night edge); LSU coming off an OT loss at Kentucky (Oct 10), so a bounce-back spot. No rivalry or homecoming bump found.
2. History/ATS: LSU has dominated the series historically; past meetings show lines from MSST -2.5 to LSU -9.5 (SI, CBS archives). No reliable 2026 ATS trend data found.
3. Coaching: Lane Kiffin (LSU, first season) runs an up-tempo RPO offense; LSU rushes about 214 ypg (Predictem). Jeff Lebby (MSST) runs an up-tempo spread built around QB Taylor's legs and arm.
4. Matchups: LSU defense allows about 176 pass ypg with nearly 4 sacks per game (Predictem); MSST OL allowed 5 sacks vs Alabama. Game on Paper adjusted EPA ranks LSU 3rd and MSST 24th (via Predictem).
5. Health: ESPN/Thamel report that Kamario Taylor (turf toe, hurt vs Missouri 9/27, aggravated vs Alabama) was downgraded to doubtful and is not expected to play; freshman Parker 'Billy' Puckett starts. RB Fluff Bothwell is also doubtful. For LSU, LB Whit Weeks plus four others are out and LB Tylen Singleton is doubtful (ESPN/SI). The final report comes 90 minutes before kickoff.
6. Stats: LSU 4-2 (W Clemson 51-10, W La Tech 45-14 with 3 Leavitt INTs, L Ole Miss, W Texas A&M 35-6, L Kentucky OT). Leavitt is about 244-261 pass ypg (StatSniper/Legion Report) and went 25/34 for 275 yards with 2 TD, 1 INT, and a fumble at Kentucky. MSST lost 56-23 to Alabama (Taylor 55.9% completions, 2 INT, -26 rush yds) and beat Missouri 31-24. Note: SI and Saturday Down South reporting conflicts with the 4-1 MSST record given in the task; a 41-21 Georgia loss was also found, but its season was unconfirmed.
7. Weather: No confirmed forecast found. WAFB (Oct 11) expected a cold front to break the October heat around this weekend; WBRZ hints rain holds off until Saturday night. Likely warm and dry at noon.
8. Experts: Dimers model 35-23 LSU (81% win, line -11.5 at the time); numberFire 83.8% LSU; Predictem picks LSU -14; A to Z Sports writers split (MSST 30-27, LSU 33-20); prediction markets 80/20. Most were published before the Taylor downgrade. ESPN FPI 76.9% LSU vs about 86% implied by the market.
9. Line movement: The spread moved from LSU -11.5 (Dimers) and -14/-14.5 (DraftKings/FanDuel, SI) to -17.5 now, and the total moved from 58.5-59.5 to 55.5-57. That movement reflects the Taylor news, so there is no public betting split edge to report.
